feed.title: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?

entry.title: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?
entry.summary:
An appreciation is extended to individuals who have taken the initiative to re-engage in important discussions relevant to Bitcoin development. Recognizing those who contribute to the continuity and progress of such conversations demonstrates a collaborative spirit within the developer community.
Active participation by group members helps ensure that critical topics receive the attention they deserve. The willingness of contributors to step forward and engage in discourse highlights a shared commitment to ongoing improvement and innovation in the field. This collective effort fosters a productive environment where ideas can be exchanged, evaluated, and implemented for the benefit of the broader ecosystem.
